title: Overdue Balance Size on a Reinstated Deduction Schedule
content:
Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement a larger overdue balance adds to the late charge rate on a deduction schedule a returned remittance reinstated, measured on the schedule's open amount:

| Open amount of the reinstated schedule | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 40000 US dollars or more | 0.15 |
| 10000 US dollars or more, below 40000 | 0.1 |
| below 10000 US dollars | none |

Hypothetical edges: 40000.00 takes 0.15; 39999.99 takes 0.1; 10000.00 takes 0.1; 9999.99 takes none.
